statement: ∀ j : Fin n, MeasurableEmbedding (insert j) ∧ MeasurePreserving (insert j) ((otherMu j).prod volume) (mu n)
proof:
intro j
classical
have hmeas : Measurable (insert j) := by
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro i
  by_cases h : i = j
  · simpa [insert, h] using (measurable_snd : Measurable (fun p : Other n j × ℝ => p.2))
  · simpa [insert, h] using ((measurable_pi_apply (⟨i,h⟩ : {i : Fin n // i ≠ j})).comp measurable_fst)
let e : (Other n j × ℝ) ≃ᵐ X n :=
  { toFun := insert j
    invFun := fun x => (fun i => x i, x j)
    left_inv := by
      intro p
      apply Prod.ext
      · funext i
        simp [insert, i.property]
      · simp [insert]
    right_inv := by
      intro x
      funext i
      by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [insert, h]
    measurable_toFun := hmeas
    measurable_invFun := (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.val)).prodMk (measurable_pi_apply j) }
refine ⟨e.measurableEmbedding, hmeas, ?_⟩
apply Eq.symm
apply Measure.pi_eq
intro s hs
have hp : insert j ⁻¹' (Set.univ.pi s) =
    (Set.univ.pi (fun i : {i : Fin n // i ≠ j} => s i.val)) ×ˢ s j := by
  ext p
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_univ_pi, mem_prod]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun i => by simpa [insert, i.property] using h i.val,
      by simpa [insert] using h j⟩
  · rintro ⟨hy,hz⟩ i
    by_cases h : i = j
    · simpa [insert, h] using hz
    · simpa [insert, h] using hy ⟨i,h⟩
rw [Measure.map_apply hmeas (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hs), hp,
  Measure.prod_prod, otherMu, Measure.pi_pi]
rw [Fintype.prod_eq_mul_prod_subtype_ne (fun i => volume (s i)) j, mul_comm]
